source_review.review_scope: Independent Sol/high review of the inspect/recover-backup extension relative to committed fd12903; local source, documentation and regular-file/mocked validation only

checks.result: Inspect takes no payload, opens namespace and p1 read-only through the existing exclusive-claim context, hashes only exact p1, and returns boot, serial/model, node identity, fixed geometry/GPT pins and zero bytes-written only after successful context postchecks.

Recovery fixes source authentication to OLD_SHA256 5860889755d7479e619e86b83bc32237e51bacd3a3fd2e2d2ebe976898f44899 before writable target admission. Caller current-target pin cannot override source digest, target, offset or extent. Existing protected root0600/single-link RAM source descriptor checks remain.

Caller current hash is checked after p1 claim and again immediately before copying, under the same held descriptors, following fresh context/identity/idle/GPT/source checks. Stale or changed current bytes refuse copying. Existing fixed-kernel/initial-namespace inode guards, process visibility, O_EXCL/flock, device geometry and pre/post GPT checks remain.

Recovery requires payload, lowercase current hash, both receipt path/digest, and existing receipt verification against old hash, exact serial/size, current boot and positive authenticated-transfer assertion. Missing or invalid admission inputs never call application. Application failures preserve null bytes_written conservatively.

Only fixed 512 MiB p1 is writable; progress, complete bounded copying including zeros, short-write handling, source postcheck, fsync/BLKFLSBUF and optional readback remain. Existing apply/rollback predecessor directions are preserved.

Procedure requires independently reverified expanded off-device old backup and newly boot-bound receipt when boot changes. It separates the historical 6401a415 writer physical application from this untested extension and does not claim interrupted-recovery acceptance.

executed_validation.command: Additional isolated mocked CLI checks via sudo python3 stdin
executed_validation.coverage: Missing payloads for all payload modes; forbidden inspect flags; current-pin rejection outside recovery; uppercase, malformed and wrong-length pins; incomplete receipts; recovery application failure with/without readback emits null bytes_written and matching persisted/stdout JSON

executed_validation.command: Python ast.parse of reviewed script/tests; git diff --check; rehash reviewed sources

limitations: Receipt verification authenticates a trusted caller assertion; the helper does not independently contact retention storage. Restored source bytes themselves must match the fixed old pin.
Trusted quiescent root remains required; advisory locks and idle census cannot prevent a deliberately racing privileged actor. Current hashes prove byte agreement rather than inspection age.

The regular-file interruption/recovery fixture preserves prefix/suffix and restores old bytes, but mocks block-device/context guards. No physical partial-write recovery, durability, BOOT, KVM, endurance or SD-write acceptance is established.

Historical physical maintenance with script SHA256 6401a4153a6bcb49c13e0fe0959383f4d2e6384c504e983d1bbe54ec3f1db975 remains historical evidence for that writer only; it was neither rerun nor reclassified.

limits: The live application and protected-host boot used historical6401 source. New inspect/recover-backup operations have no physical recovery evidence.
